api/BooseSoftware.BooseCanvas.html.title: Class BooseCanvas | BooseSoftwareDoc
api/BooseSoftware.BooseCanvas.html.summary: Class BooseCanvas Namespace BooseSoftware Assembly BooseSoftware.dll A fully functional implementation of the BOOSE BOOSE.ICanvas interface using real GDI+ graphics. All drawing operations are performed on an in-memory Bitmap that can be displayed in a PictureBox or saved to file. public class BooseCanvas : ICanvas Inheritance object BooseCanvas Implements ICanvas Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks This class replaces the broken/incomplete Canvas from the original BOOSE.dll. It supports all required turtle-style graphics commands with correct behaviour. Constructors BooseCanvas(int, int) Initializes a new instance of the BooseCanvas class with the specified size. public BooseCanvas(int xsize, int ysize) Parameters xsize int Width of the canvas in pixels. ysize int Height of the canvas in pixels. Exceptions ArgumentException Thrown when width or height is less than or equal to zero. Properties PenColour Gets or sets the current pen colour. Accepts Color objects. public object PenColour { get; set; } Property Value object A Color representing the current drawing colour. Xpos Gets or sets the current X coordinate of the drawing pen. public int Xpos { get; set; } Property Value int Ypos Gets or sets the current Y coordinate of the drawing pen. public int Ypos { get; set; } Property Value int Methods Circle(int, bool) Draws a circle with the specified radius. The circle uses the current pen position as its top-left corner. public void Circle(int radius, bool filled) Parameters radius int Radius of the circle in pixels. filled bool If true, draws a filled circle; otherwise draws an outline. Clear() Clears the entire canvas with white and resets the pen to (0,0). public void Clear() DrawTo(int, int) Draws a line from the current pen position to the specified coordinates. The pen position is updated to the end point. public void DrawTo(int x, int y) Parameters x int Target X coordinate. y int Target Y coordinate. MoveTo(int, int) Moves the pen to the specified coordinates without drawing. public void MoveTo(int x, int y) Parameters x int New X coordinate. y int New Y coordinate. Rect(int, int, bool) Draws a rectangle starting from the current pen position (top-left corner). Grows down and to the right. public void Rect(int width, int height, bool filled) Parameters width int Width of the rectangle in pixels. height int Height of the rectangle in pixels. filled bool If true, fills the rectangle; otherwise draws outline only. Reset() Clears the canvas and resets the pen colour to black. Equivalent to Clear() followed by resetting the pen. public void Reset() Set(int, int) Resizes the canvas to the new dimensions, preserving existing content where possible. public void Set(int width, int height) Parameters width int New width in pixels. height int New height in pixels. SetColour(int, int, int) Sets the pen colour using individual RGB components. public void SetColour(int red, int green, int blue) Parameters red int Red component (0–255). green int Green component (0–255). blue int Blue component (0–255). Exceptions ArgumentOutOfRangeException Thrown when any component is outside 0–255. Tri(int, int) Draws an upward-pointing triangle with its base starting at the current pen position. public void Tri(int width, int height) Parameters width int Base width of the triangle. height int Height of the triangle (distance from base to peak). WriteText(string) Draws text at the current pen position using the current pen colour. Does not change the pen position. public void WriteText(string text) Parameters text string The text to draw. Should be enclosed in quotes in BOOSE code. getBitmap() Returns the underlying Bitmap containing all drawn graphics. Used by the UI to display the canvas. public object getBitmap() Returns object The canvas bitmap.

api/BooseSoftware.MyCommandFactory.html.title: Class MyCommandFactory | BooseSoftwareDoc
api/BooseSoftware.MyCommandFactory.html.summary: Class MyCommandFactory Namespace BooseSoftware Assembly BooseSoftware.dll Custom command factory that replaces broken or missing graphics commands in the original BOOSE.dll with fully working implementations. public class MyCommandFactory : CommandFactory, ICommandFactory Inheritance object CommandFactory MyCommandFactory Implements ICommandFactory Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks This factory overrides key drawing commands (moveto, drawto, circle, etc.) while allowing all control flow and variable commands (if, for, int, etc.) to use the original BOOSE behaviour. All command names are case-insensitive. Methods MakeCommand(string) Creates a command instance based on the command name. public override ICommand MakeCommand(string commandType) Parameters commandType string The name of the command (e.g. "MOVETO", "circle").
